requests.title: Access requests
requests.subtitle: Companies asking to join the portal from the public page. A request is accepted by creating the company and inviting its administrator.

field.name: Full name
field.teamSize: People who will use the portal

accept.title: Accept and invite the administrator
accept.text: Create the company (or pick an existing one) and send the invitation to the person in the request. You can correct the name and email before sending.

reject.title: Reject
reject.text: The request stays in the “Rejected” list and is deleted after {days} days. Nothing is sent to the requester.

delete.title: Delete the request
delete.text: Deletes the request's details right away, for example if the requester asks. A company and invitation already created stay.

error.decided: This request has already been decided.
error.userExists: An account with this email already exists.
error.nameTaken: A company with this name already exists: pick it from the existing ones.
error.roleNotAllowed: This role cannot be given with an invitation.
error.name: The name must be at least 2 characters.
error.aziendaName: The company name must be at least 2 characters.

flash.requestDecided: This request has already been decided.
